category_title: Students who disengage and exhibit behavioral issues when curriculum lacks challenge and teacher communication is perceived as indirect
scenario_title: Explaining new mathematical concepts with overly complex language
minimal_context: The tutor is explaining a new mathematical concept to Raheem on the board.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at this math concept on the board. We need to utilize the inverse operations to isolate the variable by systematically applying the properties of equality.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The way you teach is so boring. It's not interesting. You're playing with words. You don't put any style or pizzazz into it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just follow along. We must transpose the constant term to the adjacent side of the equation.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: You put the work in difficult terms when it could be explained plain and simple.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I mean we just subtract the number from both sides.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why you just didn't say that in the first place instead of going through all this? You really beat around the bush instead of just getting down to the point.

TUTOR: Let's look at this math concept on the board. We need to utilize the inverse operations to isolate the variable by systematically applying the properties of equality.

TUTOR: I mean we just subtract the number from both sides.

STUDENT: Why you just didn't say that in the first place instead of going through all this? You really beat around the bush instead of just getting down to the point.

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher uses 'big words' and 'beats around the bush' instead of getting down to the point
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Questions the teacher's indirect explanation style and expresses frustration at the unnecessary complexity
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Believes the teacher intentionally puts the work in difficult terms when it could be explained simply
related_quotes: Why you just didn't say that in the first place instead of going through all this?

behavior_patterns.condition: When asking the teacher to explain a mathematical topic
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Feels the teacher is 'playing with words' rather than teaching effectively
